sources.title: 2025 Form 10-K
sources.excerpt: Dollars and shares in millions. 2025 revenue 65,179; net income 20,640; diluted EPS 22.95. Net cash provided by operating activities 16,813; purchases of property and equipment (7,841). Cash and cash equivalents 7,268. Short-term borrowings and current maturities 1,635; long-term debt 40,868. Mounjaro and Zepbound accounted for 56 percent of total revenues. Compound patent expiry: US 2036, major European countries 2037, Japan 2040. Employee benefit trust held 50 million common shares at December 31 2025 and 2024; excluded in EPS computation; dividends eliminated. Manufacturing contract commitments could require approximately $10 billion if specified purchases are not made, generally up to 8 years.

sources.title: 2026 Q2 Form 10-Q
sources.excerpt: Common shares outstanding August 3 2026: 941,357,065. Q2 2026 revenue 22,974 million versus 15,558 million; revenue increased primarily through volume, partially offset by lower realized prices. Mounjaro and Zepbound accounted for 65 percent of H1 revenue. FDA approved orforglipron for obesity; launched Foundayo in Q2 in US. Orforglipron submitted for diabetes. Phase 3 retatrutide trials met primary endpoints. Foundayo license royalties to Chugai: mid-single digits to low teens. Q1 finalized drug pricing agreements with US government including Medicare Bridge Program. In July 2026 multiple generic companies filed ANDAs for Mounjaro/Zepbound; Lilly intends to file patent infringement suits. Product liability matters also disclosed.

sources.title: Zepbound OSA approval December 20 2024
sources.excerpt: Two randomized double-blind placebo-controlled studies of 469 adults without type 2 diabetes, one on PAP and one unable/unwilling to use PAP. Zepbound 10 or 15 mg weekly for 52 weeks. Primary efficacy measure change in apnea hypopnea index at week 52; statistically significant clinically meaningful reduction versus placebo. Improvement likely related to body weight reduction. Thyroid C-cell tumors in rats; human relevance unknown; contraindicated in MTC history or MEN2. GI, pancreatitis, gallbladder and other warnings.
